shared_elements: sets of parallel curved grooves/ridges carved in relief
schematic low-relief incised linework on a three-dimensional stone form
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both show sets of parallel curved grooves in shallow relief together with a rounded, protruding boss-like volume, rendered in a comparably schematic, low-relief manner on a sculpted stone mass. What is depicted differs fundamentally: A appears to be a pillar surface bearing an arm/hand-like relief with a knob, while B is a frontal head with a scalloped headdress or hair, eyes and a bared grid of teeth, none of which recurs in A.
